title: OAG Identity Profile v1.0
description: Core identity profile for the Open Agent Governance Specification. Defines content-addressable agent identity using BLAKE3 hashing and Ed25519 signing. Conformance level: Core (MUST implement).

agentId.description: 64-character hex BLAKE3 hash computed from the canonical fingerprint string

identityAlgorithm.description: V2 canonical identity algorithm. Steps: (1) promptHash = BLAKE3(trim(systemPrompt)), (2) toolsHash = BLAKE3(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(tools))), (3) fingerprint = 'model:{model}|prompt:{promptHash}|tools:{toolsHash}', (4) agentId = BLAKE3(fingerprint)

tools.description: JSON string of tools array or object

hashAlgorithm.description: All hashing uses BLAKE3 (32-byte output, hex-encoded to 64 characters)

signingAlgorithm.description: All signing uses Ed25519 per RFC 8032 (detached signatures, 64-byte output)
